      "reason_tag": "user request",
      "rationale": "The change fixes unexpected CLI behavior where trailing flags such as -rpcwallet were silently absorbed into positional arguments instead of being parsed as options. This provides standard GNU-style argument handling for bitcoin-cli users without altering RPC wire protocols."

      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies ArgsManager option handling in src/common/args.cpp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.6,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Options following positional commands were previously swallowed silently, creating traps where options like -rpcwallet were ignored and unintended commands or wallets were targeted. Updating ArgsManager to support GNU-style conventions and the '--' terminator eliminates a subtle footgun in shared option parsing."
